pre_create_rule: Fresh reconciliation immediately before EVERY create; do not create if published, scheduled, or another executor already created materially equivalent content.
qa_gate: PASSED_FINAL_REVIEW only after visual and audio inspection of the exact final upload assets
failure_rule: Fail closed and block only affected post; no blind retry, duplicate, backdate, or uncertain publish.
publish_rule: No automatic publication unless all source reconciliation, rights, AI disclosure, correct platform format, complete native media, QA, and readback requirements have passed.

content.greek: correct Greek text; complete hook, continuity, story and caption
content.cta: Αν σας άρεσε, ακολουθήστε για περισσότερα.

narrated_video.video: MP4 H.264 30 FPS CFR from first render
narrated_video.audio: AAC; exact voice Νέστορας when narration required
narrated_video.subtitle_policy: Apply active per-series requirements; no generic text overlays on narrative images

platforms.facebook: native carousel or Reel/video as series requires
platforms.instagram: native carousel or Reel/video as series requires
platforms.tiktok: native photo carousel with autoAddMusic=true where applicable; narrated video no second music layer
platforms.youtube: complete vertical slideshow/video; single permitted instrumental layer in carousel

related_programs.youtube_zodiac_20_daily: Separate existing program, never count as one of ten and do not modify its task.
related_programs.subscriber_only_story: Separate user-directed workflow; no follow CTA for subscriber episodes.

note: This is a policy/config record, not evidence that 10 posts have been rendered or published.
